symbolic_computation.notes: One test failing due to nerdamer API limitation with definite integrals

feedback.issue: Test coverage calculation shows 109% (59 assertions vs 54 test cases)
feedback.details: This is actually a positive indicator - multiple assertions per test case provide thorough coverage. The counter-intuitive percentage could be clarified for transparency.
feedback.suggestion: Consider adding assertion count breakdown in test summary output (e.g., '54 test cases containing 59 assertions')
feedback.impact: Clarity improvement only, no functional impact

feedback.issue: Definite integral test failing: 'Definite integral: x^2 from 0 to 2'
feedback.details: Nerdamer's defint() function may not be properly exposed or may have API differences. Current pass rate is 90% (meets threshold) but one test case is failing.
feedback.suggestion: Investigate nerdamer documentation for correct definite integral syntax, or consider alternative library if this is critical functionality. Current workaround: document as known limitation.
feedback.impact: Test suite doesn't reach 95%+ in symbolic-computation, but maintains 90%+ minimum threshold

feedback.issue: KaTeX-dependent tests are skipped when KaTeX not globally installed
feedback.details: Tests gracefully skip when 'command -v katex' fails (12 tests skipped), falling back to npx which is slower in WSL. Overall test coverage still 100% for to-latex mode, but rendering tests skipped.
feedback.suggestion: Update skip messages to be more informative: 'Skipping KaTeX rendering tests - for 100% coverage run: npm install -g katex'
feedback.impact: No functional impact, minor documentation enhancement

feedback.issue: No explicit timeout mechanism on long-running computations
feedback.details: Symbolic computation operations (especially integration) on complex expressions could potentially hang indefinitely. No timeout parameter exists to prevent runaway computations.
feedback.suggestion: Consider adding optional --timeout parameter (in milliseconds) to all compute operations. Example: ./compute.sh differentiate 'expr' x --timeout 5000
feedback.impact: Safety improvement for production use with untrusted expressions
feedback.effort: Medium (requires shell wrapper for process management)
